headline: Employment of 88.9 % is clearly below the region and all schools; the not-employed share is correspondingly higher.
how_to_read: Left: all respondents; middle: employed or not; right: detailed situation, widths showing share of respondents. The hatched 'Hidden' stream marks detail cells with fewer than 3 people.
key_findings: 88.9 % are employed and 11.1 % are not; self-employed, other employment, student and other situation are each 0.0 %.
Full-time, part-time, seeking work, not seeking work and retired are hidden (fewer than 3 people), so the split behind both totals is unreadable.
benchmark: Employment is 4.3 pp below the regional 93.2 % and 3.7 pp below the 92.6 % across all schools. The not-employed share exceeds the region (6.8 %) and all schools (7.4 %) by the same margins.
caveats: With n = 27, percentages move by several points per person, so the gap may partly reflect chance.
